Requirements You are wielding your scepter regalia.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY], you can spend 1 extra action to give your follower 1 additional action (3 actions total). If you spend all 3 of your actions this way, your follower gets 4 actions instead, but must then attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}: @Check[fortitude|against:class].
